driver_archetypes.rationale: Base car type from Saval et al. Maintained to preserve discharge headway (M1/car) and stopping behavior.
Car violator type for space-seeking capacity. Params copied to match car_saval when p=0.

Base motorcycle type from Saval et al. minGapLat clipped to 0.3m (lower bound) to allow tighter packing near stop line (M4/lat_moto). Share kept high to ensure M5/moto_density is not inflated by violators.
Moto violator type for space-seeking (wrong lane, sidewalk). Share kept small (0.1) to prevent M5/length and M5/moto_density from exceeding observed values while still enabling queue_space_seeking.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator). jmTimegapMinor defaults to 1.0s for box waiting logic.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (obs 0.076). Use literature baseline p0=0.5 as per Saval; observed low share is attributed to early-start events consuming the red-light running population, reducing the net share measured at green onset.
Targets M2/early/moto (obs 0.1466). Set p to match exactly the observed share of motorcycles creeping over the stop line in the last seconds of red.

Targets M8/moto (obs wrong-lane share ~0.2145). Activate wrong-lane seeking with p_wrong_lane=0.2145 to match observed lateral encroachment and queue-jumping behaviour without relying on the 'taken by other rule' mechanism.
Targets observed behavior where most motorcycles squeeze past standing U-turners. High probability (0.9) and short wait (2s) reflect this aggressive maneuvering.
Targets conservative car behavior around U-turners. Low probability (0.1) matches field observation that cars rarely cut in.

description: Adjusted early_start share to match M2/early/moto, activated queue_space_seeking wrong-lane option to match M8/moto, and maintained high red-running baseline to compensate for early-start reduction of net violations.
